playbookOutputs: Signed 12-Month Registered Office & Domicilium Address Confirmation Letter (for CIPC CoR 21.1 and SARS RAV01 proof of address)
Active Mail-Scanning & Digital Forwarding Profile configured for 12 months
playbookCommonFailures: FICA KYC documents (Director certified ID or residential proof of address) are missing or older than 3 months
Primary contact email or WhatsApp number for urgent statutory mail forwarding (SARS/CIPC/Sheriff notices) is not confirmed

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, CIPC Registration Number & SARS Tax Reference Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the registered company name, CIPC registration number, and SARS Income Tax reference number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered company name, CIPC registration number, and SARS Income Tax reference number.

informationToProvide.label: Primary Contact Person Name, Email Address & WhatsApp/Cell Number for Mail Forwarding
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the full name, email address, and cellphone number where scanned official correspondence should be forwarded immediately upon receipt.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Authorized contact person name, email, and phone number for digital mail forwarding.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3 / CoR 39)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 or CoR 39 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 or CoR 39 registration certificate of the company.

informationToProvide.label: Certified Copy of Director(s) South African ID or Passport (FICA KYC)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a clear certified copy of the primary director's SA ID or Passport.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified South African ID document or passport of the company director for FICA compliance.

informationToProvide.label: Director Proof of Residential Address (Not Older Than 3 Months, FICA KYC)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the director's personal residential proof of address (municipal utility bill, bank statement, or lease agreement < 3 months old) for FICA compliance.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Director residential proof of address dated within the last 90 days for FICA compliance.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CoR 14.3, director FICA KYC documents and mail-forwarding contact details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company CoR 14.3, certified director ID, director residential proof of address (<90 days), and forwarding contact details are on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ensure all FICA KYC documents are on file before issuing a Registered Office Address confirmation letter.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify FICA KYC compliance and CIPC company registration details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Director ID and residential proof of address verified against CIPC CoR 14.3
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify that the director on the ID and residential proof of address is an active director listed on the company's CIPC CoR 14.3.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft 12-Month Registered Office Address Confirmation & Mandate Letter
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Official Registered Office Address Confirmation Letter (valid 12 months) drafted for CIPC and SARS use
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Generate the official Registered Office Address Confirmation Letter on letterhead confirming the physical address, erf/municipality details, and 12-month retainer validity period for CIPC CoR 21.1 and SARS RAV01 purposes.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver Registered Office Address Confirmation Letter to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed Registered Office Address Confirmation Letter posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the signed Registered Office Address Confirmation Letter and confirm the 12-month renewal date and mail forwarding email address.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the Registered Office Address Retainer order is complete
